use default
use System.Convert.to_string

successors(from: int) -> Pipe[int] is
    let n mut = from

    do
        let low = n & -n
        let ripple = n + low

        n = ripple | (((n ^ ripple) >>> 2) / low)

        yield n
    od

for start in [1, 3, 7, 15] do

    for value in successors(start) |> take(10) do
        write_line("{value,8}  {to_string(value, 2),14}")
    od

    write_line()
od
